misconceptions.description: Reusing images, charts, or icons in slides without crediting the source or license
misconceptions.trigger: learner pastes a chart from a website with no source line and no license check
misconceptions.feedback: Add a source line and confirm the license allows reuse. 'Found online' is not a citation.

misconceptions.description: Failing to disclose AI-generated text, images, or narration when the assignment requires it
misconceptions.trigger: learner uses an AI-written summary as their own words with no AI note
misconceptions.feedback: Disclose AI assistance where required and attribute generated media; undisclosed AI use is an integrity risk.

misconceptions.description: Treating citations as decoration added at the end rather than verifiable links to sources
misconceptions.trigger: learner lists a URL that does not actually contain the cited figure
misconceptions.feedback: Each citation must point to the exact source of the claim or media; check that the link supports what you said.
